title: W10785366A — Dishwasher Service Diagnostics cycle
description: 1-2-3 × 3 key sequence invokes Service Diagnostics cycle when door closes.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Connected Smart Appliances — Third Generation (Job Aid W10785366A)

steps.title: Invoke Service Diagnostics cycle
steps.body: Standby: press any 3 keys 1-2-3-1-2-3-1-2-3 with no more than 1 second between presses. Close door to start. START/RESUME rapid-advances intervals.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press any 3 keys in the sequence 1-2-3-1-2-3-1-2-3.
